name: ferrata_attestation
docs: The attestation program of Ferrata on LEZ v0.4 (RFP-021). Hand-written IDL in SPEL's format: SPEL's stable release targets LEZ v0.2.4, so the program is written against LEZ v0.4 directly, and this IDL describes its borsh interface.
Each instruction is a variant of the borsh enum named by instruction_type; discriminator is its one-byte variant index, followed by args in order.

PDA seeds: an actor's seed is SHA-256("ferrata-lez/v1/" || tag || parts), with u64 parts little-endian; its account is LEZ v0.4's AccountId::for_public_pda(program, seed). instance_id = SHA-256("ferrata-lez/v1/instance-id" || borsh(Config) || checkpoint).
Refusals exit with one byte: 1-61 and 100-199 the core's, 80-99 the step API's, 200-217 this program's (lez/wire CODE_BLOCKS). A refusal reverts the whole transaction on v0.4.

Events: FRT-FIN1 (finalized header advanced), FRT-UPG1 (store moved to a later fork's layout), FRT-ATT1 (Attest as a transaction's root: instance id, chain id, block number LE, then each statement id).

instructions.name: init

accounts.name: instance
docs: instance(instance_id(config, checkpoint)), created: the transaction carries LEZ's PDA evidence for its seed

accounts.name: job
docs: the job that adopts the bootstrap's committee
Create an instance from a bootstrap matching checkpoint, and open the job that adopts its committee. Anyone may call.

instructions.name: open

accounts.name: job
docs: job(id, job_id): job_id hashes the instance, its store digest and the update
Step 1 of an update (CompactUpdate, SignerWitness encodings): opens job(id, job_id). Anyone may call; no step checks a sender.

instructions.name: miller
docs: Step 2, at the job: the Miller loops.

instructions.name: adopt

accounts.name: instance
docs: the last part of Init's adoption only: activates the instance

accounts.name: header
docs: the last part of Init's adoption only: the bootstrap header's record
One part of the job's committee adoption: n / parts uncompressed keys.

instructions.name: finish

accounts.name: instance
docs: receives Apply

accounts.name: header
docs: receives Record when a new header is finalized
Step 3, at the job: the final exponentiation, then Apply to the instance.

instructions.name: read

accounts.name: receiver
docs: any actor of this program; replies StateReply with its state
Reply with this actor's state (LEZ v0.4's read idiom).

instructions.name: read_padded

accounts.name: receiver
docs: any actor of this program
As Read, carrying bytes the program ignores (cost measurement).

instructions.name: attest

accounts.name: header
docs: header(id, slot): the record the request is proven under
Prove the facts of request under this record; reply with an Attestation, or, as a transaction's root, emit the FRT-ATT1 event. Changes no state.

instructions.name: verify_all

accounts.name: receiver
docs: any actor of this program, meant to run privately; sends ApplyVerified to instance(id)
The private placement: the whole verification of one update in one call.

instructions.name: job_open

accounts.name: job
docs: from instance(id) only
Internal: instance(id) -> job(id, job_id), the job step 1 produced.

instructions.name: apply

accounts.name: instance
docs: from job(id, job_id) only
Internal: the verified job, applied to the instance (compare-and-swap on the store digest).

instructions.name: apply_verified

accounts.name: instance
docs: from any actor of this program (authenticated by program)
Internal: a job verified in one call by VerifyAll.

instructions.name: record

accounts.name: header
docs: from instance(id) only; written once
Internal: the record to write once (HeaderRecord encoding), with the instance's chain id and root id.

instructions.name: succeed

accounts.name: instance
docs: instance(parent): checks the successor's config against its own and that checkpoint is its finalized header; sends Spawn

accounts.name: successor
docs: instance(successor_id), successor_id = SHA-256("successor-id" || root_id || parent || config || checkpoint), created by Spawn
Spawn a successor of this instance with a new fork schedule, from its finalized header, inside its weak-subjectivity period; emits FRT-SUC1. Anyone may call.

instructions.name: spawn

accounts.name: instance
docs: instance(successor_id): from the parent instance only; created active with the parent's store
Internal: the parent instance -> the successor it spawns.

type.name: InstanceState
docs: instance(id): store is the CompactStore encoding; active once the initial committee is adopted. root_id: the id of the first instance of its line (its own id for an Init); parent_id: the instance a successor was spawned from (zero for an Init).

type.name: JobState
docs: job(id, job_id).

type.name: RecordState
docs: header(id, slot), written once: record is ferrata_core::witness::HeaderRecord's encoding; root_id: the instance line's root id, which an Attest request may name instead of the instance.

types.name: Config
docs: The chain an instance follows. Fixed at Init; part of the instance id. store_fork: 0 Altair, 1 Capella, 2 Deneb, 3 Electra, 4 Gloas. ws_period_epochs: the weak-subjectivity period of the finalized header (nonzero); Init, Open, VerifyAll and Succeed are valid only before it ends.

types.name: Message
docs: Every message the program handles (ferrata_lez_wire::Message): a borsh enum, one byte of variant index then the fields.

types.name: Cmp
docs: A comparison of two 256-bit unsigned values.

types.name: Field
docs: A field of a fact, as a 256-bit word. Topic(i): log topic i; DataWord(i): the i-th 32-byte word of a log's data.

types.name: Condition
docs: field <cmp> rhs (rhs big-endian).

types.name: Operand
docs: A field of one of the request's facts, by the fact's position in the reply.

types.name: SlotQuery
docs: storageProof[i].proof of eth_getProof.

types.name: AccountQuery
docs: accountProof of eth_getProof, and slots of the account's storage.

types.name: LogQuery
docs: The log at log_index (from zero within the receipt) of the receipt of transaction tx_index, with the receipt's proof in the receipts trie.

types.name: LeafQuery
docs: A leaf of the accumulator whose root is the value of the storage fact at position root of the reply, with its siblings.

types.name: Hop
docs: One EIP-2935 hop to an older block: proofs in the state of the block hopped from, and the older block's RLP header.

types.name: Request
docs: What a consumer asks of header(id, slot). header: the RLP header of the record's block when the record binds a block hash only (Gloas layout).

types.name: Fact
docs: A proven fact.

types.name: Statement
docs: A fact with its statement identifier.

types.name: Attestation
docs: The reply to Attest: facts in the order each account, then its slots, then the logs, then the leaves.

errors.name: Malformed
errors.msg: SSZ input is malformed: wrong length, bad offset, or wrong shape for the fork.

errors.name: CheckpointMismatch
errors.msg: Bootstrap header root differs from the trusted checkpoint root.

errors.name: BootstrapHeaderInvalid
errors.msg: Bootstrap header fails `is_valid_light_client_header`.

errors.name: CurrentCommitteeBranchInvalid
errors.msg: Bootstrap `current_sync_committee` branch does not verify against the state root.

errors.name: ParticipationLow
errors.msg: Fewer than `MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS` signers.

errors.name: AttestedHeaderInvalid
errors.msg: Attested header fails `is_valid_light_client_header`.

errors.name: SlotOrderInvalid
errors.msg: Violates `current_slot >= signature_slot > attested_slot >= finalized_slot`.

errors.name: PeriodSkipped
errors.msg: Signature period is neither the store period nor (with a known next committee) the next.

errors.name: UpdateIrrelevant
errors.msg: Update neither advances the store nor supplies the missing next committee.

errors.name: FinalizedHeaderInvalid
errors.msg: Finalized header is invalid, or non-empty when it must be empty.

errors.name: FinalityBranchInvalid
errors.msg: Finality branch does not verify against the attested state root.

errors.name: NextCommitteeBranchInvalid
errors.msg: Next-sync-committee branch does not verify against the attested state root.

errors.name: NextCommitteeMismatch
errors.msg: Next committee contradicts the one the store already holds for that period.

errors.name: NextCommitteeUnexpected
errors.msg: A non-sync-committee update carries a non-empty next committee.

errors.name: SignatureInvalid
errors.msg: The aggregate signature does not verify.

errors.name: SignatureMalformed
errors.msg: The signature is not a valid compressed G2 point in the prime-order subgroup.

errors.name: PubkeyInvalid
errors.msg: A public key fails `KeyValidate`: not a curve point, the identity, or outside G1.

errors.name: SigningKeyIdentity
errors.msg: The signing key (aggregate of the signers) is the identity point.

errors.name: CommitteeInvalid
errors.msg: A committee key fails `KeyValidate`, or the keys do not sum to `aggregate_pubkey`.

errors.name: NotFinalized
errors.msg: Ferrata policy: only finality updates may advance an instance.

errors.name: BelowSupermajority
errors.msg: Ferrata policy: participation is below the supermajority (2/3) floor.

errors.name: NotNewer
errors.msg: Ferrata policy: the update does not advance the finalized header (duplicate or stale).

errors.name: OutsideWeakSubjectivityPeriod
errors.msg: Ferrata policy: the store's finalized header is older than its weak-subjectivity period at the current slot (`crate::ws`); recover from a new bootstrap.

errors.name: CommitteeUnknown
errors.msg: Store invariant: next committee unknown and the update finalizes outside the store period.

errors.name: ForkMismatch
errors.msg: Data of one fork was handed to a store of another (or a downgrade was requested).

errors.name: RlpNonCanonical
errors.msg: RLP that is not the canonical encoding: a non-minimal length, a long-form length with a leading zero, a single byte below 0x80 wrapped as a string, or an integer with a leading zero byte.

errors.name: RlpMalformed
errors.msg: RLP that is truncated or does not have the expected shape: a length past the end of the input or of the enclosing list, bytes after the item, a list where a string belongs (or the reverse), a wrong item count or field size, or an integer too large for its field.

errors.name: ProofNodeMismatch
errors.msg: Inclusion proof: a node's Keccak-256 differs from the root or from its parent's reference.

errors.name: ProofIncomplete
errors.msg: Inclusion proof: the proof ends before the walk reaches a value or the key's absence.

errors.name: ProofTrailingNodes
errors.msg: Inclusion proof: elements remain after the walk ended.

errors.name: ProofNodeInvalid
errors.msg: Inclusion proof: a node is not a canonical trie node (item count, hex-prefix flag or padding, empty extension path, child reference, empty value, or a node shorter than 32 bytes referenced by hash).

errors.name: HeaderHashMismatch
errors.msg: keccak256 of an RLP block header differs from the hash it must match.

errors.name: HeaderUnsupported
errors.msg: A block header that is not of the Cancun (20 fields), Prague/Osaka (21) or Amsterdam (23) layout.

errors.name: ReceiptNotIncluded
errors.msg: The receipts trie has no receipt at the requested transaction index.

errors.name: ReceiptUnsupported
errors.msg: A pre-Byzantium receipt (state root instead of status) or an unknown receipt type.

errors.name: ReceiptFailed
errors.msg: The transaction failed (receipt status 0).

errors.name: LogIndexOutOfRange
errors.msg: The receipt has no log at the requested position.

errors.name: PredicateFailed
errors.msg: A condition of the statement does not hold.

errors.name: QueryInvalid
errors.msg: A condition names a field its fact does not have, or the query is empty.

errors.name: ChainMismatch
errors.msg: The record belongs to another chain than the consumer is configured for.

errors.name: BindingMismatch
errors.msg: The finalized header does not carry the execution binding the record constructor reads.

errors.name: HistoryOutOfWindow
errors.msg: EIP-2935: the older block is not among the 8191 blocks before the record's block.

errors.name: HistoryHashMismatch
errors.msg: EIP-2935: the history slot does not hold keccak256 of the supplied header.

errors.name: HistoryContractMissing
errors.msg: EIP-2935: no history contract with the specified code in the record's state.

errors.name: AccumulatorPathInvalid
errors.msg: Accumulator: the path does not have 32 siblings.

errors.name: AccumulatorIndexOutOfRange
errors.msg: Accumulator: the leaf index is 2^32 or more (it would share a path with its low 32 bits).

errors.name: AccumulatorLeafEmpty
errors.msg: Accumulator: the leaf is the empty leaf (32 zero bytes).

errors.name: AccumulatorRootMismatch
errors.msg: Accumulator: the path does not hash the leaf to the attested root.

errors.name: Witness
errors.msg: The signer witness does not fit the committee: wrong count, encoding, key or branch.

errors.name: Phase
errors.msg: The step does not follow the job's last one (skipped or replayed).

errors.name: StoreChanged
errors.msg: The job was started on a store with another digest.

errors.name: AdoptionIncomplete
errors.msg: The update adopts a committee whose adoption is not complete.

errors.name: NoAdoption
errors.msg: The job adopts no committee, or its adoption is already complete.

errors.name: BAD_MESSAGE
errors.msg: The message does not decode.

errors.name: WRONG_RECEIVER
errors.msg: The receiver is not the actor the message is for.

errors.name: WRONG_SENDER
errors.msg: An internal message from an actor other than the expected one.

errors.name: ALREADY_INITIALIZED
errors.msg: `Init` on an instance that exists.

errors.name: NO_INSTANCE
errors.msg: No instance at the receiver.

errors.name: NO_JOB
errors.msg: No job at the receiver.

errors.name: INSTANCE_INACTIVE
errors.msg: An update for an instance whose initial committee is not adopted yet.

errors.name: JOB_EXISTS
errors.msg: A job that is already open.

errors.name: RECORD_CONFLICT
errors.msg: A record that already holds another header.

errors.name: BAD_STATE
errors.msg: Stored state that does not decode.

errors.name: UNROUTABLE
errors.msg: A read with no one to reply to.

errors.name: WRONG_INSTANCE
errors.msg: A message about another instance than the receiver's: an internal message, or an attestation asked of a record of another instance than the caller is bound to.

errors.name: BAD_CONFIG
errors.msg: An unknown store layout in a config.

errors.name: NO_RECORD
errors.msg: An attestation asked of an actor that holds no record.

errors.name: BAD_QUERY
errors.msg: An attestation request the program cannot serve: an accumulator leaf whose root is not a storage fact of the same request, or a block header sent for a record that holds the payload's fields and needs none.

errors.name: HEADER_REQUIRED
errors.msg: An attestation asked, without the block's header, of a record that binds a block hash only (a finalized header in the Gloas layout): `Request::header` must carry the RLP header that hashes to it.

errors.name: BAD_SUCCESSOR
errors.msg: A successor whose configuration is not its parent's with another fork schedule: an immutable field changed (the chain, the preset, the genesis, the weak-subjectivity period, the adoption parts), a fork at or before the checkpoint's epoch changed, a store layout other than the parent store's, a schedule that is not in order, or no change at all.

errors.name: STALE_CHECKPOINT
errors.msg: A successor from a checkpoint that is not the parent's latest record.
